label: D2 after a2 -> S2 (common) when the previous trial was unrewarded, late in the episode
explanation: Fires only at D2 (never D1/GO), essentially only when the agent chose a2 and reached S2 via the common transition (in_action=2, in_state=2), and almost only when the previous trial was unrewarded (98% of mass at prev_reward=0). It is strongly time-dependent: silent in the first ~30 episode trials and rate rises steadily to trials 80-99 (99% of mass at ep_trial >= 50), so the ep_trial cutoff is an approximation of a gradual ramp. It does not fire on a1/S1 or rare transitions, and little after the agent was on a1 the previous trial. All variables are observable at D2 (this trial action/state are known by then). Magnitude is higher when the previous trial was also a2 and unrewarded (often rare), i.e. after a run of non-reward on the a2 side, and when value is low; ~0.2 when the preceding trial was rewarded. Precision is limited (~0.65) because many matching steps stay silent, probably depending on the slowly drifting episode-time or value signal.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=D2 & choice_bin=decile 4 (9 = most a1) (+4.26), phase=D2 & last=a2 S2 u (+3.83), phase=D2 & before=a2 S1 u (+3.35), phase=D2 & value_bin=decile 1 (9 = highest) (+3.19), phase=D2 & last=a2 S1 u (+3.05), phase=D2 & value_bin=decile 0 (9 = highest) (+2.70). Lower it: ep_dec=0 (-5.70), in_state=0 (-4.97), prev_action=1 (-4.09), in_state=1 (-3.68).
